bullets.text: In Ponneri, contract worker families staged a sit-in protest demanding compensation after an accident at the Kattupalli desalination plant, and the office should monitor relief measures.
ADMK criticized TVK over a fake AI-generated advertisement, and the portfolio team should watch for emerging political misusing of artificial intelligence tools.
News18 Tamil Nadu broadcast live updates on Tamil Nadu political developments including Chief Minister Vijay, and the office should track ongoing political reactions.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Chennai to launch Rs 13,000 crore development projects and ride the metro with Chief Minister Vijay, and the office should watch transport updates.
Chennai metro rail services from Poonamallee to Vadapalani were launched today, and the office should review transit schedule details.
Traffic changes were implemented across Guindy, Meenambakkam, and other areas in Chennai for the Prime Minister's visit, and the constituency team should monitor commuter advisories.
